name: Tunupa volcano crater viewpoint
why: From Coquesa, on the shore of the salt flat, up to the multicoloured crater of Tunupa with the white Salar spreading to the horizon.
book: Community fee at Coquesa (also for the mummy cave). Most come with a 4x4 tour from Uyuni.
water: No water on the mountain: carry 3 litres.
dangers: Altitude: the viewpoint is at about 4,900 m.

points.name: Coquesa
points.note: A hamlet on the north shore of the Salar, at the foot of the volcano.

points.name: Tunupa crater viewpoint
points.note: A lookout into the red, yellow and orange crater.
